function.name: _app_permission_create
function.description: Create a custom application permission (AppPermissionDefine). Before creating, call _app_permission_list and _query_app_define_designer to avoid duplicate moduleId + key. Use App for app-level permissions. If binding to a table module, pass the table key as moduleId; the system stores the internal module ID.

moduleId.description: Permission owner module. Use App for app-level permissions. other module ID from _query_app_define_designer.

key.description: Custom permission identifier, unique under the same moduleId. Must not use built-in permission names such as AppAccess, TableQuery, TableInsert, TableUpdate, or TableDelete.
